targets.title: ESA WorldCereal 10 m 2021 v100
targets.description_head:
ESA WorldCereal 2021 products v100

The European Space Agency (ESA) WorldCereal 10m 2021 product suite consist of global-scale annual and seasonal crop maps and (where applicable) their related confidence. Every file in this repository contains up to 106 agro-ecological zone (AEZ) products which were all processed with respect to their own regional seasonality and should be considered as independent products.

Naming convention of the ZIP file

Field 01.structure: two cycles: summer crop then short second crop
Field 01.uncertainty_cycle_1: green-up observed, bracket 10 days plus 10 to 20 day sowing offset assumption
Field 01.uncertainty_cycle_2: green-up interpolated inside a 45 day gap, bracket 45 days

Field 02.structure: two cycles: summer crop then short second crop
Field 02.uncertainty_cycle_1: green-up observed, bracket 20 days plus offset assumption
Field 02.uncertainty_cycle_2: green-up interpolated inside a 40 day gap, bracket 40 days

Field 03.structure: two cycles: summer crop then short second crop
Field 03.uncertainty_cycle_1: green-up observed, bracket 20 days plus offset assumption
Field 03.uncertainty_cycle_2: green-up interpolated inside a 40 day gap, bracket 40 days

method.threshold: p10 + 0.5 * (p90 - p10) of the smoothed season NDVI
method.sowing_note: greenup is a proxy; sowing precedes it by roughly 10 to 20 days

zarc_comparison.verdict: both observed green-ups fall inside the ZARC windows after applying the 10 to 20 day offset assumption; the second crop green-up sits inside a 40 to 45 day observation gap, so the date is interpolated, not observed

limits_recorded: December 2025 and January 2026 have 1 to 3 usable scenes per field after the cloud mask
the second crop green-up falls inside a 40 to 45 day observation gap in all three fields
peak NDVI of the two crops differs by at most 0.03, so NDVI does not separate soy from maize
the fixture ground truth is synthetic and carries no dates and no source
ZARC windows are municipal and per soil, not per field
